newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso names two new ministers-official.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso names two new ministers-official.

text.p: President Fernando Henrique Cardoso has named two congressmen as Brazil's new ministers of justice and transportation, a presidential palace spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman said Senator Iris Resende was named to the justice post and Deputy Eliseu Padilha was named transportation minister. Both are members of the government-allied Brazilian Democratic Movement Party (PMDB) party.
"They were invited to assume the posts and both accepted the invitation," she said, adding no date had been set yet for their swearing in.

Resende, who hails from the central Brazilian state of Goias, will fill the post vacated by former justice minister Nelson Jobim, who has been named a justice of Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal.
Padilha, from the southern state of Rio Grande do Sul, replaces the post left by Odacir Klein, who stepped down after his son killed a man in a hit-and-run accident 10 months ago.
